New episodes of 9to5Mac Daily are recorded every weekday. Subscribe to our show on Apple Podcasts or your favourite podcast platform to make sure new episodes are delivered straight to your ears as soon as they're released.

News mentioned in this episode:

  • AT&T appears to have no plans to support the Handoff feature on Apple's new iPhone
  • Disney+ and Hulu have raised their prices—see the latest charges
  • Apple says a software update to fix the iPhone 18 Pro reboot bug will be released next week
  • iPhone 18 Pro Face ID bug causes some users' systems to crash and restart
  • iOS 27.0.1 update coming soon to iPhone
